Let \\(\\{a_{s,k}\\}_{s\\in S}\\) be a family of sequences such that:
1. For every positive integer \(k\\ge 1\), \(a_{s,k}\	o a_k\).
2. There exists a nonnegative sequence \(M_k\), independent of \(s\), such that for every \(k\), \( |a_{s,k}|\\le M_k \), and
\\[
\\sum_{k\\ge 1} M_k<\\infty.
\\]
Then
\\[
\\sum_{k\\ge 1} a_{s,k}\	o \\sum_{k\\ge 1} a_k.
\\]
